name: ComponentChangeoutTracker
tagline: Major component life, changeout planning and rebuild-pool coverage for mining fleets – in one Power Apps component.
description: Track engines, transmissions, final drives, wheel motors and struts by hours against target life, forecast end of life from utilisation, plan changeouts week by week against workshop capacity, record changeouts that install a spare from the pool in one step, follow components through the rebuilder and see failures before life. Works immediately with demo data; connect a collection, Dataverse, SharePoint or Excel table and map columns from dropdowns.
features: Life used vs target with due-soon / watch / over-life bands
End-of-life forecast from hours and utilisation
Drag-to-plan week board with workshop capacity flags
Max life extension rule for plans
Changeout dialog: reason, failure mode, hours, spare from pool
Rebuild pool lanes: removed, at rebuilder, spare
Spare coverage vs forecast demand per type and model
Failures before life, failure-mode Pareto, life achieved by type
Bulk plan / clear plan / meter update, CSV export
Undo for every change, validation, read-only and disabled states
Phone, tablet and desktop layouts; keyboard and ARIA support
pack: Niray Mining & Natural Resources PCF Pack
